tokens.name: paperTop
tokens.usage: The paper: the ground of every screen. Text on it is ink or inkSecondary.

tokens.name: cardFill
tokens.usage: The fill of every card, sheet and dialog (see the Card component).

tokens.name: surfaceSunken
tokens.usage: A ground sunk below the paper, such as a track behind a control.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The one point edge round a card.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: The one pixel line between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text and the interactive colour on paper and on cards. Never a brand hue.

tokens.name: inkSecondary
tokens.usage: Secondary lines and every label (section, field, toggle), on paper and cards.

tokens.name: inkFaintIcon
tokens.usage: A dimmed glyph with no text of its own; it clears the contrast floor for marks that are not text. Never for text.

tokens.name: iconInk
tokens.usage: The app icon's line art, warmer than ink so it holds on any highlighter.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The interactive colour on paper is ink; there is no brand hue (#1676).

tokens.name: onAccent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on an accent (ink) fill.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: The one bright colour, butter by default. Views read the musician's chosen highlighter, never this token directly. A fill only, with ink on it; never text on paper, where it all but vanishes.

tokens.name: marker-butter
tokens.usage: The butter highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.

tokens.name: marker-coral
tokens.usage: The coral highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.

tokens.name: marker-mint
tokens.usage: The mint highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.

tokens.name: marker-sky
tokens.usage: The sky highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.

tokens.name: marker-lavender
tokens.usage: The lavender highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.

tokens.name: marker-sage
tokens.usage: The sage highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.

tokens.name: marker-peach
tokens.usage: The peach highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.

tokens.name: marker-powder
tokens.usage: The powder highlighter, one of the eight the musician can choose; a fill under ink, used where marker is.

tokens.name: onMarker
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on the highlighter fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors: a brick red pulled toward brown.

tokens.name: dangerWash
tokens.usage: A wash of danger shared by an error banner and what it points at.

tokens.name: dangerBanner
tokens.usage: A wash of danger: the error banner's fill.

tokens.name: dangerEdge
tokens.usage: A faded danger: the edge of a danger surface.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: A faint ink: the colour of the card lift.

tokens.name: buttonShadow
tokens.usage: A faint ink: the colour of the primary button lift.

tokens.name: sheetScrim
tokens.usage: A faded black: the dimmed ground behind a floating sheet.

tokens.name: tabBarFill
tokens.usage: The tab bar's fill.

tokens.name: pieceBadgeBg
tokens.usage: Blue-grey: a piece's badge and bar. Duller than the marker so a badge never reads as a button.

tokens.name: pieceBadgeFg
tokens.usage: Text on pieceBadgeBg.

tokens.name: exerciseBadgeBg
tokens.usage: Sand: an exercise's badge and bar. Duller than the marker so a badge never reads as a button.

tokens.name: exerciseBadgeFg
tokens.usage: Text on exerciseBadgeBg.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Mastery gains, clean reps, trending up: an olive green. Kept apart from danger.

tokens.name: masteryFill
tokens.usage: Mastery is monochrome ink; the count carries the meaning. Never recolour by level.

tokens.name: masteryTrack
tokens.usage: The empty track of a mastery meter.

tokens.name: dialTrack
tokens.usage: The empty track of a dial.

tokens.name: timerTrack
tokens.usage: The empty track of the session timer.

tokens.name: consistencyTrack
tokens.usage: The empty track of the consistency chart.

tokens.name: repMissedFg
tokens.usage: A missed rep's mark: taupe, never red. Calm, not shaming.

tokens.name: repMissedBg
tokens.usage: A missed rep's ground.

tokens.name: repCleanFg
tokens.usage: A clean rep's mark.

tokens.name: repCleanBg
tokens.usage: A clean rep's ground.

tokens.name: repCleanBorder
tokens.usage: A clean rep's edge.

tokens.name: slotOutline
tokens.usage: An empty rep slot's ring and the missed button's border.

tokens.name: addDashOutline
tokens.usage: The dashed outline on full-width add rows.

tokens.name: inkFainter
tokens.usage: A very faint ink for marks, not text.

tokens.name: playerBgTop
tokens.usage: The top stop of the focus player's warm radial backdrop.

tokens.name: playerBgMid
tokens.usage: The middle stop of the focus player's backdrop.

tokens.name: playerBgBottom
tokens.usage: The outer stop of the focus player's backdrop.

tokens.name: heroGradientTop
tokens.usage: The top of the Practice hero card's gradient.

tokens.name: heroGradientBottom-butter
tokens.usage: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the butter highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.

tokens.name: heroGradientBottom-coral
tokens.usage: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the coral highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.

tokens.name: heroGradientBottom-mint
tokens.usage: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the mint highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.

tokens.name: heroGradientBottom-sky
tokens.usage: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the sky highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.

tokens.name: heroGradientBottom-lavender
tokens.usage: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the lavender highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.

tokens.name: heroGradientBottom-sage
tokens.usage: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the sage highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.

tokens.name: heroGradientBottom-peach
tokens.usage: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the peach highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.

tokens.name: heroGradientBottom-powder
tokens.usage: The bottom of the Practice hero gradient when the powder highlighter is chosen: its hue darkened, so light text and the marker button hold contrast.

tokens.name: onHeroExercise
tokens.usage: An exercise's accent on the dark hero.

tokens.name: onHeroPiece
tokens.usage: A piece's accent on the dark hero.

tokens.name: celebrationBg
tokens.usage: The celebration toast's dark ground.

tokens.name: celebrationInk
tokens.usage: Text on celebrationBg.

tokens.name: viewerBackdrop
tokens.usage: The full-screen photo viewer's ground: a warm near-black, so cream never tints a photograph.

styles.name: pageTitle
styles.usage: The page title, the largest of the five sizes.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A hero heading or the key picker.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body text, values and fields: anything the musician reads or sets, in ink.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Names a section, a field or a toggle, above what it names, in inkSecondary, sentence case.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A value that is only a number: a clock, a duration, a count.

styles.name: smallMedium
styles.usage: Tabs, badges and chips with emphasis.

tokens.name: spacing-segmentGap
tokens.usage: IntradaSpacing.segmentGap: between the segments of a strip, and the strip and its labels.

tokens.name: spacing-controlGap
tokens.usage: IntradaSpacing.controlGap: the gap between controls.

tokens.name: spacing-cardCompact
tokens.usage: IntradaSpacing.cardCompact: a card's inset in a dense list.

tokens.name: spacing-card
tokens.usage: IntradaSpacing.card: a card's inset from its edge.

tokens.name: spacing-section
tokens.usage: IntradaSpacing.section: the gap between sections.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: IntradaRadius.card: every card and inset surface, and the primary button.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: IntradaRadius.control: interactive control buttons (rep Clean and Missed).

tokens.name: radius-badge
tokens.usage: IntradaRadius.badge: type badges and small tinted chips.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: IntradaRadius.panel: medium section and hero cards.

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: IntradaRadius.hero: the Practice hero, the largest card.

shadow.note: From IntradaShadow (colour, radius, y). A SwiftUI shadow radius is not a CSS blur; the blur here is the SwiftUI radius written as is.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: IntradaShadow.card: the faint lift under every card on paper, in the shadow colour.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: IntradaShadow.button: the primary button's lift, in the buttonShadow colour.

tokens.name: shadow-lifted
tokens.usage: IntradaShadow.lifted: a control while the musician drags it.

tokens.name: shadow-glow
tokens.usage: IntradaShadow.glow: a soft glow in the accent (ink).

tokens.name: shadow-transport
tokens.usage: IntradaShadow.transport: the lift under the player's transport controls.

tokens.name: shadow-heroButton
tokens.usage: IntradaShadow.heroButton: the lift under a button on the dark hero.

tokens.name: shadow-hero
tokens.usage: IntradaShadow.hero: the Practice hero, the only card that floats this far.

tokens.name: shadow-appIcon
tokens.usage: IntradaShadow.appIcon: the app icon's lift, in ink at the wash opacity.

tokens.name: opacity-wash
tokens.usage: IntradaOpacity.wash: a faint tint washing a surface, such as a pressed capsule or a card on a dark hero.

tokens.name: opacity-dimmed
tokens.usage: IntradaOpacity.dimmed: a row or figure that is disabled, unplayed or superseded.

tokens.name: opacity-soft
tokens.usage: IntradaOpacity.soft: a softened fill or edge that still reads as the colour it came from, such as the ends of the title swipe.

tokens.name: opacity-secondary
tokens.usage: IntradaOpacity.secondary: secondary text or glyphs on a dark or photographic ground.

tokens.name: opacity-strong
tokens.usage: IntradaOpacity.strong: a ground or text that must hold contrast over anything beneath it.

tokens.name: icon-badge
tokens.usage: IntradaIconSize.badge: a glyph inside a badge or count chip.

tokens.name: icon-caption
tokens.usage: IntradaIconSize.caption: a glyph beside small text, such as the priority star on a library row.

tokens.name: icon-inline
tokens.usage: IntradaIconSize.inline: a glyph beside body text, and the plus in the round add button.

tokens.name: icon-control
tokens.usage: IntradaIconSize.control: a glyph that is a control on its own, such as the back chevron.

tokens.name: icon-large
tokens.usage: IntradaIconSize.large: a large glyph, such as an empty state's picture.

tokens.name: icon-transport
tokens.usage: IntradaIconSize.transport: the player's play and skip glyphs.

tokens.name: icon-hero
tokens.usage: IntradaIconSize.hero: the largest glyph, on a hero.

tokens.name: glyph-bar
tokens.usage: IntradaGlyph.bar: the instrument icon in the header button.

tokens.name: glyph-tile
tokens.usage: IntradaGlyph.tile: the instrument icon on a picker tile.

tokens.name: glyph-hero
tokens.usage: IntradaGlyph.hero: the instrument icon on the profile hero.
